account: Tata Elxsi proposes a system that combines health-data collection, remote patient monitoring, and AI decision support. Its submission to the International Telecommunication Union (ITU), current as of June 2025, places the system in initial discussion and development, with some features intended for controlled or shadow-mode evaluation. Better access, earlier intervention, and reduced hospital pressure are intended benefits. The interim ITU report of July 2025 printed a benefits section about sixth-generation vehicle-to-everything (6G-V2X) networks under this entry, and the final report replaced it with healthcare benefits. On 2 December 2025 Tata Elxsi announced a separate rural kiosk program in Illinois with the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign and OSF HealthCare. No source reports that any patient, clinic or health system used the product or gained a result.
